# Sofora — full reference for AI consumers

  (placeholder contact details — the live site carries the real ones)

## The pay-on-delivery model (canonical)

1. The customer orders online with name, phone, and delivery address only. No payment details are collected online.
2. Sofora confirms the order by phone call or text, checking the address and agreeing a delivery slot.
3. A two-person delivery team brings the sofa to the customer's room of choice.
4. The customer inspects the sofa (fabric, fit, finish) and then pays the driver.
5. Accepted payment methods at the door: cash, card machine, bank transfer.
6. If the customer is not happy at the door, they may refuse delivery and pay nothing.

## Delivery & policies

- Free UK delivery on orders over £500; £29 below that.
- Typical delivery time: 7–14 days; slot agreed by phone before dispatch.
- Inspect at the door before paying; refuse delivery with no charge if not satisfied.
- Full policies: /delivery, /returns, /privacy.

## Frequently asked questions

- Do I pay anything online? No. You place the order with your details only. Payment is made to the driver when the sofa arrives.
- How can I pay the driver? Cash, card machine, or bank transfer.
- What if I don't like it at the door? Inspect before paying; refuse delivery and pay nothing if it isn't right.
- How long does delivery take? Typically 7–14 days; we call first to agree a slot.
- More: see the FAQ section on / and /sofas/[slug] pages (FAQPage structured data).
